thread:
rita: Quick preflight for docs release notes publish (v0.9.4-docs). Need three small fixes before we merge: SDK python auth snippet, embeddings migration example, and some broken anchors found by link-check. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4625
jordan: I can run the link-check and sweep anchors. Point me at the pages if you know them.
katie: I'll own the python snippet. Which SDK min version should we call out?
rita: Callout should say "requires SDK >= 0.6.2" per release plan. Add it above the snippet as a single-line compatibility note.
phil: I'll add the embeddings old->new 3-line diff to the migration guide and a short migration blurb in the relnotes bullets.
rita: Thanks. Also need one-line marketing-safe bullets about Dedicated burst pools and latency SLO change. Keep them super short.
phil: Draft two bullets: "Dedicated: burst pools support mixed CPU/GPU configurations for cost predictability." and "Latency SLO: median latency improved; no API changes." Posting in the PR for copy edit.
jordan: Link-check run -> found 2 broken anchors on deploy/regions.md (heading rename) and one stale internal link in quickstart.md pointing to /embed-streaming. I'll push fixes in a tiny PR.
doc-ci: FYI: anchor-checker found: deploy/regions.md#regional-zones (missing) and quickstart.md#embed-streaming (404 anchor). Recommend updating headings or adding redirects.
katie: PR #4620 created for python snippet update. I replaced old client init and added a one-line test harness snippet in examples/python/snippets/auth_fix.md. Description: "docs: update python auth snippet"
rita: Nice. Please include the compatibility banner in that file.
katie: Done in the PR. Added: "Compatibility: SDK >= 0.6.2" above code block.
jordan: PR #4622 opened for anchor fixes and a redirect suggestion in _redirects.yml. I also added anchor-checker step to .github/workflows/release-notes.yml so relnotes PRs run checks.
rita: Perfect. Can you mark your PR title with "docs: fix anchors" so the changelog generator picks it up?
jordan: Will do.
phil: Embedded migration snippet pushed in #4623. Short diff example included. Also left TODO to delete old quickstart mention of embed streaming. Rita, do you want the old line removed now or after copy edit?
rita: Remove it, but replace with one-line pointer to the migration guide. We want no stale examples on publish.
doc-ci: CI queue: #4625 (relnotes), #4620 (python snippet), #4622 (anchors), #4623 (embed migration). All jobs scheduled.
rita: Final ask: everyone add a one-line PR description starting with "docs:" so the automated changelog picks up the entry. I'll do final review once CI is green and merge for a 07:00 UTC publish.
katie: done.
jordan: done, link-check green locally.
phil: done.
rita: Thanks team — if anything flakes in CI ping here. I'll hold the publish window for 07:00 UTC tomorrow. :rocket:
